entries.mechanism: EUROMOD BE_2025 applies the February-through-December 2025 ONSS worker work-bonus table to all 12 months of the full-year equal-month case, while the statutory RuleSpec applies the separate January 2025 table for one month and the February table for 11 months. The gross 13.07 percent Article 38 contribution before reductions matches exactly; only the reduction timing differs. The 2026-07-05 rerun (axiom-oracles#125) measures the residual at EUROMOD's post-uprating gross of 31,650.67 EUR, where it is 17.11 EUR; the ledger entry records the same issue at the raw 30,000 EUR gross, where it was 11.65 EUR.

The net employee-contribution residual is exactly the opposite side of the work-bonus timing residual on the same case: the gross 13.07 percent Article 38 contribution on EUROMOD's post-uprating gross of 31,650.67 EUR, minus the work-bonus reduction. Nothing else in the contribution chain differs.

Historical harness artifact, kept for provenance: the 2026-07-02 be-worker-ssc run compared EUROMOD at its post-uprating gross (31,650.67 EUR, dataset uprating factor 1.05502) against Axiom at the raw 30,000 EUR input, so both engines applied the identical 13.07 percent rate to different bases. Resolved by the feed-forward bridge that evaluates Axiom at EUROMOD's returned gross (axiom-oracles#76, closed); the gross concept now matches exactly, so this entry stays expired unless the bridge regresses.
